leadText:
----
 
Pokémon the Movie: Koko Music Collection (Japanese: 「劇場版ポケットモンスター　ココ」ミュージックコレクション) is the Japanese soundtrack for the twenty-third movie. It was released in Japan on December 23, 2020.

Pokémon the Movie: Koko Music Collection (Japanese: 「劇場版ポケットモンスター　ココ」ミュージックコレクション) is the Japanese soundtrack for the twenty-third movie. It was released in Japan on December 23, 2020.

==Tracklist==
 

== Trivia ==

"The Regeneration of the Forest" is a remix of "Farewell, Children of the Future" from the twelfth movie's soundtrack, Arceus: To a Conquering Spacetime Music Collection.
